note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22; 16 trial pictures made, 8 chosen). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured, and Adam, Enoch, Lamech, Noah and the rest are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: This is the family record of humankind, which began when God made people, male and female, in his own likeness, blessed them and named them.
ideas: An old family photo album lies open at its first pages: a wedding photograph of a young man and woman at the top, rows of children and families below
A young man and woman stand hand in hand in a morning meadow as sunlight breaks through the clouds onto them
A newborn boy and a newborn girl lie side by side in soft morning light
A crowd of people of every age and kind walk together across a square
A mother and father lean over a cradle, naming their first child
A man and woman exchange rings in a sunlit field
A long hallway lined with family portraits, oldest at the far end
A child's hand pressed into wet clay, leaving its print
Two hands, a man's and a woman's, joined in the light
A tree of many branches spreading from one strong trunk on a hill

sections.meaning: Adam's son was born in his own likeness, so the likeness God gave passes from father to child; and Adam, after all his long years, died.
ideas: A father and his small son stand side by side in profile, the same hair, the same face, the same stance, the boy a small copy of the man
A father and his small son face each other nose to nose, laughing, their two faces plainly alike
A father holds up his newborn son face to face
A father and son walking away, the same shape and the same stride
A father's shadow and his son's shadow on a sunlit path, the same shape in two sizes
A man holds an old photo of himself as a boy beside his son, who looks just like it
A father and son shaving side by side at one mirror
A father's large hand and his son's small hand side by side, the same shape
Grandfather, father and son in a row, one face at three ages
An empty armchair with an old man's hat and reading glasses on it

sections.meaning: Life after life runs the same course: a man lives, fathers a son who carries the line on, has more children, and dies.
ideas: Four hands laid one on another on a kitchen table: an old man's, a middle-aged man's, a young man's and a child's
Five generations of one family on a farmhouse porch, a very old man holding a baby, his son, grandson and great-grandson behind
A man stands at his father's grave holding his own small son's hand, both seen from behind
A small family burial plot of plain headstones under an oak beside a farmhouse, children playing on the lawn beyond
A relay runner hands the baton to the next runner
An old pocket watch passed from an old man's hand into his son's
A forest with trees of every age side by side, from an old giant to a sapling
A hallway of framed portraits, old black and white ones giving way to colour
Waves arriving one after another on a shore
An old rocking chair on a porch, now with a young father in it rocking his baby

sections.meaning: Enoch walked with God, and his story alone does not end with 'he died': he was no more, because God took him.
ideas: An old man with a walking stick walks up a ridge path, seen from behind, into a bright white cloud lit from within
A line of footprints across fresh snow that simply stops in the middle of an open field
A small child walks hand in hand with his father along a country lane, seen from behind
An old man walks along a beach at dawn toward a bright horizon
A garden path leading into dazzling morning light, an empty bench at its end
A man walks a long quiet road at sunrise, steady and at peace
A sailboat sails out into a bright morning haze until it is almost gone
A walking stick leaning on a gate at the top of a hill, the path beyond full of light
Two chairs side by side on a porch at evening, one empty
A mountain summit above the clouds in clear bright light

sections.meaning: Even the longest life ever recorded ends the same way: and he died.
ideas: An enormous ancient tree, centuries old, lies fallen full length across the forest floor, roots in the air
An ancient gnarled mountain pine, thousands of years old, bleached silver and dead
An hourglass with the last grains of sand falling
A tall grandfather clock in an empty hall, its pendulum stopped
A very old man's deeply wrinkled hands folded on a blanket
An old stone farmhouse standing empty after centuries
The sun setting at the end of a very long summer day
A great old oak letting fall its last leaf
A candle burned down to the very end
A worn path that ends at the edge of the sea

sections.meaning: A father worn out by hard work on cursed ground names his newborn son for comfort, hoping this child will bring rest.
ideas: A farmer's rough, cracked, dirt-stained hands gently cradle a sleeping newborn, a hard stony field behind
A weary farmer in a sweat-stained shirt sits on his truck's tailgate at dusk at the edge of a field of thistles, holding his newborn son
A father in dusty work clothes asleep in a chair with his baby asleep on his chest
A coal miner with a blackened face holds his newborn baby
A single bright flower growing out of dry cracked earth
A tired father comes in from the fields and his wife puts the baby in his arms
A worker's muddy boots by the door beside a baby's tiny shoes
A construction worker on a lunch break looking at a photo of his baby
A father carries his newborn out to show him the field at sunrise
Rough hands holding a cup of cool water after hard work

sections.meaning: Lamech's life ends, and the line comes down to Noah and his three sons.
ideas: A father walks out along a farm track at morning with his three young sons beside him, seen from behind
A father and his three grown sons stand side by side on a hilltop, seen from behind, looking out over a valley
Three young brothers sit on a fence beside their father
A father and three sons at a table, sharing bread
Three boys' heights marked on a door frame
A father with three sons building a fence together
Three small pairs of boots beside a father's big pair
A father carries one son on his shoulders with two more beside him
Three young trees planted in a row beside a big one
A family of a father and three sons rowing a boat together

scenes.principle: This is the book of the generations of Adam: God made humankind in his likeness, male and female, and blessed them.
scenes.shows: An old family photo album open at its first pages, a wedding photograph of a young man and woman at the top and rows of children and families below.
scenes.prompt: On a wooden table by a sunny window lies a large old family photo album, open at its first pages. At the top of the left page is one faded wedding photograph of a young man and a young woman standing side by side. Below it and across the right page are rows of small photographs of babies, children and growing families, more and more of them down the pages, the start of a long family line. Soft warm daylight falls across the open book.

scenes.principle: Adam fathered a son in his likeness, according to his image.
scenes.shows: A father and his small son stand side by side in profile, the boy a small copy of the man.
scenes.prompt: A father and his small son of about five stand side by side in profile on a grassy rise, both looking out at the same view. The boy is a small copy of his father: the same dark curly hair, the same nose and chin, the same stance with hands in pockets, the same plain blue shirt. Clear afternoon light.

scenes.principle: Seth fathered Enosh, Enosh fathered Kenan: life after life, each father has a son who carries the line on.
scenes.shows: Five generations of fathers and sons on a farmhouse porch, a very old man holding a baby.
scenes.prompt: Five generations of one family on the porch of a farmhouse: a very old great-great-grandfather sits in a chair holding a baby boy on his lap, and standing behind him in a row are his grey-haired son, his middle-aged grandson and his great-grandson, a young father. Each man looks like the one before him. Soft daylight.

scenes.principle: And all his days were so many years, and he died: each one dies, and his son carries on.
scenes.shows: A man stands at his father's grave holding his small son's hand, both seen from behind.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet green country graveyard of plain old weathered headstones with no writing on them, under big oak trees, a man in a dark coat stands at one grave holding the hand of his small son. Both are seen from behind, looking down at the stone. Gentle soft overcast light. No church or steeple.

scenes.principle: Enoch walked with God, and he was no more, because God took him.
scenes.shows: An old man with a walking stick walks up a ridge path, seen from behind, into a bright white cloud lit from within.
scenes.prompt: An old man with a walking stick walks steadily up a narrow path along a high grassy mountain ridge, seen from behind. Ahead of him the path rises into a bright white cloud lit from within by sunlight, and the top of the path vanishes into the soft glowing brightness. Clear blue sky above. The man is ordinary, not glowing.

scenes.principle: Methuselah lived nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.
scenes.shows: An enormous ancient tree, centuries old, lies fallen full length across the forest floor.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet old forest of giant trees, an enormous ancient tree, wider than a house and many centuries old, lies fallen full length across the forest floor, its huge roots torn up into the air. Soft shafts of daylight fall through the tall trees still standing around it.

scenes.principle: This one will bring us comfort from our work and from the painful toil of our hands, from the ground that Yahweh has cursed.
scenes.shows: A farmer's rough, cracked, dirt-stained hands gently cradle a sleeping newborn, a hard stony field behind.
scenes.prompt: Close up: a farmer's rough, cracked, dirt-stained hands, calloused from years of hard work, gently cradle a tiny sleeping newborn baby wrapped in a soft white blanket. Behind, out of focus, a hard dry field of stones and thorny weeds. Warm evening light.

scenes.principle: Lamech died, and Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
scenes.shows: A father walks out along a farm track at morning with his three young sons beside him, seen from behind.
scenes.prompt: A father walks out along a dirt farm track across wide green fields in the morning with his three young sons beside him, the boys of three different heights, all four seen from behind. Clear fresh morning light over the open land ahead.
